spec.section:
## Preconditions
- Controller and `chd-archive` are reachable; `chd` writes report `fsync` and readback. - Archive ingestor credential is available to the ingestor only. - Native importer/exporter reports supported `hermes.session.export` versions. - The source session, agent, profile, and checkpoint boundary are identified.

## Procedure
1. Trigger at `turn_end`, configured checkpoint interval, bond retirement, or session end. 2. Freeze the checkpoint boundary only after covered controller writes have durable `fsync` acknowledgements. 3. Serialize the native payload; calculate byte count and `sha256`; record coverage window, room/thread refs, source host, schema name/version. 4. Validate `export-envelope.schema.json` and write a staging object. Do not advertise staged bytes. 5. Compare `(session_id, checkpoint_seq, payload_digest)`: exact replay returns the existing manifest; a changed digest is a conflict. 6. Append payload, manifest, and session-index updates as prepared archive constituents; fsync and read back each, then append the archive commit marker last. Do not describe these independent writes as atomically committed by DuckBrain. 7. Read back the marker, payload, manifest state, digest, checkpoint, completeness and gaps. 8. On any failure, commit a failed manifest plus `ArchiveGapRecord`; never report a silent stop. 9. Record retention deadline and preserve manifests/gaps required by open audits.

## Evidence
Capture the exact manifest key/revision, payload digest, `X-Durability` where applicable, coverage window, checkpoint sequence, `open_gaps`, and readback timestamp. Do not claim continuous backup; state the last committed checkpoint and named gaps.

## Rollback / recovery
Do not overwrite an immutable manifest. Retry the same identity for an exact replay, or capture a later checkpoint that subsumes the gap and records the supersession.
